mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_reminder (user_id, openid, enabled, remain_count, total_auth_count, total_sent_count, remind_hour, remind_minute) VALUES (#{userId}, #{openid}, #{enabled}, #{remainCount}, #{totalAuthCount}, #{totalSentCount}, #{remindHour}, #{remindMinute})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_reminder SET enabled = #{enabled}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE user_reminder SET remain_count = remain_count + #{count}, total_auth_count = total_auth_count + #{count}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE user_reminder SET remind_hour = #{hour}, remind_minute = #{minute}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE user_reminder SET remain_count = remain_count - 1, total_sent_count = total_sent_count + 1, last_remind_date = #{today}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND remain_count > 0
UPDATE user_reminder SET last_remind_date = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE last_remind_date IS NOT NULL
